q.en: How do I apply for a passport?

sw.text: Ombi la pasipoti linaanzia mtandaoni kwenye tovuti ya Uhamiaji.
steps: Fungua immigration.go.tz, chagua e-Services, kisha Online Passport Application.
Bofya OMBI JIPYA na jaza taarifa zako.
Ambatisha picha na vielelezo, kisha hakiki na thibitisha ombi.
Fuata maelekezo ya malipo kwa control number.
Chapisha fomu na uiwasilishe pamoja na vielelezo kwenye Ofisi ya Uhamiaji husika.

en.text: A passport application starts online on the Immigration website.
steps: Open immigration.go.tz, select e-Services, then Online Passport Application.
Click New Application and complete your details.
Attach your photograph and supporting documents, then check and confirm the application.
Follow the control-number payment instructions.
Print the form and submit it with the supporting documents to the relevant Immigration Office.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.sw: Ni vielelezo gani vinahitajika kwa pasipoti?
q.en: What documents are needed for a passport?

list: Cheti chako cha kuzaliwa au cha tajnisi.
Cheti au kiapo cha kuzaliwa cha mmoja wa wazazi, au cheti chake cha tajnisi.
Kitambulisho cha NIDA.
Nakala ya pasipoti ya mzazi (kama anayo).
Barua ya maombi.
Uthibitisho wa shughuli unazofanya au sababu ya safari yako.
sw.note: Vielelezo vya ziada vinaweza kuombwa kulingana na hali yako.

list: Your birth or naturalisation certificate.
A parent's birth certificate or affidavit, or naturalisation certificate.
Your NIDA identity card.
A copy of a parent's passport (if available).
An application letter.
Evidence of your occupation or purpose of travel.
en.note: Additional supporting documents may be requested for your circumstances.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.en: What types of passports are there?

list: Pasipoti ya Kawaida — hutolewa kwa raia wa Tanzania kwa safari za nje ya nchi.
Pasipoti ya Utumishi — hutolewa kwa wenye sifa zilizoainishwa kisheria.
Pasipoti ya Kidiplomasia — hutolewa kwa wenye sifa zilizoainishwa kisheria.

en.text: There are three types of passports:
list: Ordinary Passport — issued to Tanzanian citizens for international travel.
Service Passport — requires the eligibility specified by law.
Diplomatic Passport — requires the eligibility specified by law.
en.note: Select any image to enlarge it.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.sw: Ada ya pasipoti ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much is the passport fee?

sw.text: Ada ya pasipoti ukiomba ukiwa Tanzania ni Tsh 150,000. Inalipwa kwa awamu mbili:
steps: Ukimaliza kujaza fomu mtandaoni, unalipia Tsh 20,000 (ada ya maombi).
Unakamilisha taratibu zote na kuwasilisha fomu pamoja na viambatisho kwenye Ofisi ya Uhamiaji, ambapo zinakaguliwa.
Mwisho unalipia Tsh 130,000 kwa control number.
sw.note: Malipo yote hufanywa kwa control number kupitia simu au benki. Ukiomba ukiwa nje ya nchi (kupitia Ubalozi), ada ni USD 90, inayolipwa yote baada ya kujaza fomu.

en.text: The passport fee when applying in Tanzania is Tsh 150,000, paid in two instalments:
steps: After completing the online form, pay Tsh 20,000 (application fee).
Complete all requirements and submit the form with attachments at the Immigration Office, where they are checked.
Finally, pay Tsh 130,000 using the control number.
en.note: All payments are made with a control number via mobile money or bank. If you apply from abroad (through an Embassy), the fee is USD 90, paid in full after completing the form.

source.document: immigration.go.tz — Passport Fee (Matrix Fee for Passports)

q.en: How do I pay for a passport?

sw.text: Malipo hufanywa kwa control number uliyopewa kwenye ombi lako.
list: Zingatia aina ya fedha na kiasi kilichoainishwa kwenye control number.
Malipo ya ndani yanaweza kufanywa kwa simu au benki.

en.text: Payment is made using the control number issued for your application.
list: Use the currency and amount specified with the control number.
Domestic payments can be made by mobile payment or bank.
en.note: Do not hand cash to an officer to pay on your behalf.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.en: How do I track my passport application?

steps: Fungua Online Passport Application kupitia e-Services kwenye immigration.go.tz.
Chagua ANGALIA OMBI kufuatilia ombi ulilokamilisha.
Kama bado hujakamilisha fomu, chagua ENDELEZA OMBI.
Open Online Passport Application through e-Services at immigration.go.tz.
Select Check Application to follow a completed application.
If your form is unfinished, select Continue Application.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.sw: Pasipoti yangu imepotea au imeibiwa, nifanye nini?
q.en: My passport is lost or stolen — what do I do?

steps: Toa taarifa polisi.
Toa taarifa kwa maandishi kwenye Ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu nawe. Ukiwa nje ya nchi, wasiliana na Ubalozi.
Tangaza upotevu kwenye magazeti mawili: moja la Kiswahili na moja la Kiingereza.
Andaa tamko la kisheria (statutory declaration).
Jaza ombi la pasipoti iliyopotea.
Report the loss to the police.
Report in writing to the nearest Immigration Office. If abroad, contact the embassy.
Publish notices in two newspapers: one in Kiswahili and one in English.
Prepare a statutory declaration.
Complete an application for a lost passport.
en.note: The circumstances of the loss will be verified.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.en: My passport is damaged — what do I do?

steps: Jaza ombi la pasipoti nyingine mtandaoni.
Andaa barua inayoeleza mazingira ya kuharibika kwa pasipoti.
Wasilisha pasipoti iliyoharibika wakati wa kuomba nyingine.
Complete an online replacement application.
Prepare a letter explaining how the passport was damaged.
Submit the damaged passport with your application.

source.document: MWONGOZO WA HUDUMA YA PASIPOTI NA HATI ZA KUSAFIRIA.pdf

q.en: How do I apply for a Tanzania visa?

steps: Fungua immigration.go.tz, chagua e-Services, kisha e-Visa Application Form.
Tumia email yako na hifadhi namba ya maombi utakayopewa.
Jaza fomu na ambatisha picha na nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa aina ya visa yako.
Fuata maelekezo ya malipo na uwasilishe ombi.
Open immigration.go.tz, select e-Services, then e-Visa Application Form.
Use your email and keep the application number you receive.
Complete the form and upload the photograph and documents required for your visa category.
Follow the payment instructions and submit the application.

q.en: How do I track my visa application?

steps: Ingia kwenye mfumo wa maombi ya visa kwa kutumia namba yako ya maombi.
Angalia maendeleo ya ombi au pakua Visa Grant Notice.
Angalia pia email uliyotumia kwenye maombi kwa taarifa zinazotumwa kuhusu ombi lako.
Sign in to the visa application portal using your application identification number.
Check progress or download your Visa Grant Notice.
Also check the email address you used in your application for updates.

q.sw: Je, nahitaji visa tofauti kwa Zanzibar?
q.en: Do I need a separate visa for Zanzibar?

sw.text: Hapana. Ukitembelea Tanzania Bara na Zanzibar, chagua mahali utakapoanzia safari wakati wa kujaza fomu. Unaweza kutembelea sehemu zote mbili bila kuomba visa nyingine kwa sababu ya kuvuka kati ya Bara na Zanzibar.

en.text: No. When visiting both Tanzania Mainland and Zanzibar, select your first destination in the application. You can visit both without obtaining a second visa solely for travelling between Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar.

q.sw: Je, watoto wanahitaji ombi lao la visa?
q.en: Do children need their own visa application?

sw.text: Ndiyo. Kila mwenye pasipoti anatakiwa kuwasilisha ombi lake la visa. Hata mtoto aliyetajwa kwenye ombi la mzazi anatakiwa kuwa na ombi lake tofauti.

en.text: Yes. Each passport holder needs a separate visa application. A child included in a parent's application still needs a separate application.

q.en: Does a visa guarantee entry?

aliases: can entry be refused with a visa

sw.text: Hapana. Visa Grant Notice haimaanishi kuingia nchini kunaruhusiwa moja kwa moja. Afisa Uhamiaji kwenye kituo cha kuingilia atakagua kama umetimiza masharti ya kuingia.

en.text: No. A Visa Grant Notice does not guarantee entry. The Immigration Officer at the entry point checks whether you meet the entry requirements.

q.sw: Kuna madaraja gani ya vibali vya ukaazi?
q.en: What classes of residence permits are there?

sw.text: Vibali vya ukaazi vina madaraja matatu:
list: Class A — wageni waliojiajiri au wawekezaji.
Class B — wageni walioajiriwa kwenye kampuni au taasisi binafsi.
Class C — makundi mengine kama watafiti, wastaafu, wamisionari na watu wa kujitolea.
Class A — self-employed foreigners or investors.
Class B — expatriates employed by companies or private institutions.
Class C — other categories such as researchers, retirees, missionaries and volunteers.

q.en: How do I apply for a residence permit?

aliases: jinsi ya kuomba kibali cha kuishi
how to apply for a residence permit

sw.text: Njia inategemea kama shughuli yako inahitaji Work Permit:
list: Inahitaji Work Permit: anza maombi ya pamoja kupitia kazi.go.tz. Baada ya idhini ya Work Permit, fuata hatua za Residence Permit kwenye mfumo wa Uhamiaji.
Haihitaji Work Permit: tumia Online Residence Permit Application kupitia e-Services kwenye immigration.go.tz — fungua akaunti, jaza fomu na ambatisha nyaraka zilizothibitishwa.

en.text: The route depends on whether your activity requires a Work Permit:
list: Work Permit required: start the combined application through kazi.go.tz. After Work Permit approval, follow the Residence Permit steps in the Immigration system.
No Work Permit required: use Online Residence Permit Application under e-Services at immigration.go.tz — create an account, complete the form and attach certified documents.

q.sw: Je, niombe kibali kabla ya kuingia Tanzania?
q.en: Must I apply before entering Tanzania?

aliases: kuomba kibali kabla ya kuingia tanzania
apply residence permit before entering tanzania

sw.text: Ndiyo. Maombi ya Residence Permit yanapaswa kuwasilishwa ukiwa nje ya Tanzania na kuidhinishwa kabla ya kuingia nchini.
sw.note: Kama tayari upo nchini na hali yako ni tofauti, wasiliana na Idara kupitia info@immigration.go.tz kwa mwongozo wa kesi yako.

en.text: Yes. Residence Permit applications should be submitted while you are outside Tanzania and approved before entry.
en.note: If you are already in the country and your circumstances differ, contact info@immigration.go.tz for guidance on your case.

q.sw: Ninafuatiliaje ombi la kibali cha ukaazi?
q.en: How do I track my residence permit application?

sw.text: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya maombi. Utaona sehemu hizi:
list: Submitted Application Status — huonyesha hali ya ombi.
Pending Application — kuona na kujibu maombi ya taarifa au nyaraka zinazokosekana.
Pending Payment — huonyesha maelekezo ya malipo.

en.text: Sign in to your application account. You will see these sections:
list: Submitted Application Status — shows progress.
Pending Application — view and respond to requests for missing information or documents.
Pending Payment — shows payment instructions.

q.sw: Ombi langu lina nyaraka pungufu, nifanye nini?
q.en: My application has missing documents — what now?

sw.text: Utaarifiwa kupitia mfumo wa Residence Permit au email ya akaunti yako.
steps: Ingia kwenye akaunti na fungua Pending Application.
Jibu hoja au ambatisha nyaraka zilizoombwa ili ombi liendelee.

en.text: You will be notified through the Residence Permit system or your account email.
steps: Sign in and open Pending Application.
Respond to the query or upload the requested documents so processing can continue.

q.sw: Alama za vidole na picha huchukuliwa lini?
q.en: When are fingerprints and photo taken?

aliases: alama za vidole kibali cha kuishi

sw.text: Baada ya malipo, utapokea Residence Permit Enrolment Notification. Fuata maelekezo yake ya kufika Ofisi ya Uhamiaji kwa kuchukuliwa alama za vidole na picha.

en.text: After payment, you will receive a Residence Permit Enrolment Notification. Follow its instructions to attend an Immigration Office for fingerprints and a photograph.

q.en: How much are the fees?

sw.text: Ada hutofautiana kulingana na huduma. Andika huduma unayoulizia, kwa mfano “ada ya pasipoti”, “ada ya visa” au “ada ya kibali cha ukaazi Class B”, nami nitakuonyesha jedwali rasmi la ada kutoka immigration.go.tz.
sw.note: Kiasi cha mwisho cha kulipa huonekana kwenye control number ya ombi lako.

en.text: Fees depend on the service. Type the service you are asking about, for example “passport fee”, “visa fee” or “residence permit class B fee”, and I will show you the official fee table from immigration.go.tz.
en.note: The final amount to pay appears with your application's control number.

q.en: How do I contact the Immigration Department?

sw.text: Tuma barua pepe kwa info@immigration.go.tz au tembelea tovuti rasmi immigration.go.tz. Unaweza pia kufika Ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu nawe.

en.text: Email info@immigration.go.tz or visit the official website immigration.go.tz. You can also visit the nearest Immigration Office.
